title: Do not replay transcript search jumps on content updates
outcome: Scroll review through commit 856d5df. With Find open and a selected match, scroll away from that match and let new output arrive. The viewport jumps back despite remaining in STAY. SessionPaneView.tsx:535-560 rebuilds the search index and match objects when activeSession changes; SessionPaneView.scroll.ts:2998-3031 depends on the match object identity and unconditionally calls scrollIntoView, so an unchanged logical match is treated as new navigation. Earlier temporary hook probe reproduced top 120 -> user PageDown 290 -> unrelated assistant append 120, with unchanged itemKey but a new match object. The probe was removed; latest pass was code-only and confirmed this path unchanged. This violates the September 3 FOLLOW/STAY specification. Observe explicit query/Next/Previous navigation separately from content-driven recomputation.
acceptance: With a selected search match, subsequent reader scrolling is preserved through streaming, new messages, status updates and history residency changes when the logical selection is unchanged. Explicit query changes and Next/Previous still navigate correctly. Add regression coverage exercising the real scroll hook rather than mocking it out; demonstrate failure before the fix. TypeScript and affected search/scroll suites pass.
